entities.summary: Isatou Ceesay is a Gambian activist and social entrepreneur, sometimes referred to as the Queen of Recycling. She initiated a recycling movement called One Plastic Bag in the Gambia. Through this movement, she has trained women in The Gambia to recycle plastic waste into sellable products, providing them with a source of income.
